part.text: The sticky cookie currently leaves `Secure`/`SameSite` unset for secure requests. I'll fix it so the cookie is `SameSite=None` always and `Secure` when the request is secure.

part.text: Fixed. In `modules/caddyhttp/reverseproxy/selectionpolicies.go:718`, the sticky cookie is now always set with `SameSite=None` and `Secure` matches whether the request is secure — so third-party contexts keep the `lb` cookie. All reverseproxy tests pass, including the cookie hash policy tests.
